'''Brendan Hillin''' was a employee of [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] who worked at the [[CZ-198]] research facility. Hillin stored a tin of [[warra nut]] cookies in the employee refrigeration unit, but later found that [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Faye]] had eaten them and left a [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]] of him doing so in their place. Furious, Hillin filed a formal complaint calling for Faye's firing to the corporation's [[Czerka Sentient Resources Department|Sentient Resources Department]].<ref name="Formal Complaint" />
